author: wesley
title: Explanatory Notes upon the New Testament: St. John
edition: John Wesley, Explanatory Notes upon the New Testament (London, 1755), CCEL edition ("Wesley's Notes on the Bible"; CCEL does not name the printing it follows)

rights.worldwide: to confirm: Wesley died in 1791; the printing CCEL transcribed (and any editor of it) is still to identify

notes: One excerpt per verse note, whole: Wesley's notes are short, so each note is taken as it stands, with its verse number and lemmas. A note that runs into numbered points (John 10:27–29, 13:14, 14:31, 17:21, 20:23) keeps them as further paragraphs. The outline that opens chapter 17 is one excerpt on the whole chapter. Headings are the note's first lemma, empty where the note has none.
